summary: This bill authorizes the Secretary of Education to award competitive grants to local educational agencies to hire armed school resource officers and establish single points of entry with locked anterooms and metal detectors at elementary and secondary schools.

scores.thoughts: This bill authorizes the Secretary of Education to make grants to local educational agencies for physical improvements, specifically for hiring armed school resource officers and establishing secure single points of entry with metal detectors. This directly involves federal spending directed towards public schools for specific safety measures.
